item.title: bussilab.coretools v0.0.52
item.description: • Removed the unused file_or_path() helper. • Fixed TestCase.assertEqualFile() to close the first file when opening the second file fails. • Made config_path() use Path.home() for the default configuration path, allowing home directory lookup when HOME is unset. • Documented configuration loading and fixed the Result constructor example.
item.content:encoded:
• Removed the unused file_or_path() helper.
  • Fixed TestCase.assertEqualFile() to close the first file when opening the second file fails.
  • Made config_path() use Path.home() for the default configuration path, allowing home directory lookup when HOME is unset.
  • Documented configuration loading and fixed the Result constructor example.
